verdict: C3.ai's turnaround quarter took revenue down 25% to $52.4M as professional services shrank, but costs fell faster, free cash flow turned positive, and the GAAP loss narrowed to $92.8M.

kpis.label: Revenue
kpis.note: -25% YoY, from $70.3M — the company called it 'on plan'

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs -$0.86 a year ago; non-GAAP loss per share was -$0.20

kpis.label: Cash & marketable securities
kpis.note: Up $76M in the quarter, helped by $72.8M from stock option exercises

kpis.label: Bookings
kpis.note: Growth in new bookings versus the prior quarter, per the company; 22 agreements closed

segments.name: Subscription
segments.note: Subscriptions to the C3 AI platform and applications — 94% of revenue. Down from $60.3M a year ago.

segments.name: Professional services
segments.note: Implementation help, training and paid 'prioritized engineering' — building requested features sooner. Down from $10.0M a year ago as that work was wound down.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and AI applications. Down from $64.7M a year ago after restructuring.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: The sales organisation, which was restructured this year. Down from $62.5M a year ago.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and admin. Up slightly YoY.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Turnaround restructuring charges, mainly vendor consolidation costs.

otherDetail: Interest income of $5.957M, less $0.338M of other expense, for net other income of $5.619M.

takeaways.title: Revenue shrank — services most of all
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 25% to $52.4M. Subscription revenue fell 18% to $49.2M, and professional services fell 68% to $3.2M as paid feature-acceleration work dried up. Management guided next quarter to $51M–$55M and the full year to $210M–$240M.

takeaways.title: Costs fell faster than revenue
takeaways.text: Total costs and running expenses dropped from $195.1M to $150.6M in a year, so the operating loss narrowed from $124.8M to $98.3M. GAAP gross margin was 32% (50% before share-based pay). On the company's non-GAAP basis the operating loss was $36.2M.

takeaways.title: Cash flow turned positive
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow and free cash flow were both about +$2.1M, versus a $34.3M free-cash outflow a year ago. With $651.1M of cash and marketable securities, the company has a long runway — though $59.2M of the quarter's costs were share-based pay, a real cost paid in stock rather than cash.

oneTimers: Restructuring charges were $0.7M this quarter, part of the turnaround plan that reorganised sales, services and products.
Share-based compensation was $59.2M — more than the quarter's revenue. Excluding it, employer payroll taxes on it and restructuring, the non-GAAP net loss was $30.7M.
footerNote: C3.ai reports in thousands; figures are shown in $M with decimals so the lines add up exactly. This is a loss quarter: the shortfall is covered by the company's cash on hand.

sources.label: Official earnings release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
